race.comment: GRINZINGER LASS (4) lines up on the back of a 1.75-length fourth over 1600m at this track three weeks ago. Is very effective at this distance with two wins and three minors from six runs. Looks to have an edge on most of these. FLYING START (3) scored by half a length two back at this track then filled a placing last time at this track. Gets a little weight relief. Paul Denton who has two wins when partnering stays on. Best form puts him right in this. DELAGO LAD (2) raced below his best last time when seventh over 1200m at this track, beaten 16 lengths. That was in open class and much better placed here. Can make amends. BAHAMA BAY (1) was unplaced two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1200m at this track, beaten 4.5 lengths into fourth. No surprise to see him in contention. IZ SHAFT (5) cannot be underestimated.
